item.title: Tomb Raider: Catalyst Briefly Listed for Switch 2
item.description:
The gaming world has a lot of massive franchises out there, many of which are still going with new games to this day, and one of the most iconic is about to receive its first mainline entry in almost a decade. Tomb Raider: Catalyst marks the return of Lara Croft to our screens, and although there has been no confirmed release date yet, some strange listings may indicate it is coming sooner rather than later and to more platforms than expected as well.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover
Every Tomb Raider Game, Ranked

Tomb Raider is an all-time great franchise with many great games, but not all of Lara Croft's adventures are equal.

By Melody MacReady

Amazon Games, the publisher of the series, updated its news site in early November, listing Tomb Raider: Catalyst for Nintendo Switch 2, with a 2028 release year. Since then, all references to a Switch launch and the year have been removed, but it makes things a lot more interesting, given how Legacy of Atlantis is scheduled for February 2027 and will also be getting a Switch 2 version.

Tomb Raider: Catalyst May Be Heading To Switch 2 In 2028

Back in the early gaming days, a select few franchises dominated the release calendar, and one of those was Tomb Raider . As gaming's leading lady, we got to venture into tombs, explore lush forests, and uncover grand conspiracies, with a few supernatural elements as well, but since 2018, we have yet to receive a new mainline entry. That all changed when both the remake, Legacy of Atlantis , which is getting its release in early 2027, and Catalyst. The latter still has no concrete release date, but a slight slip-up on the publishing side may have just shown when and where it will be released.

It makes things a lot more interesting, given how Legacy of Atlantis is scheduled for February 2027 and will also be getting a Switch 2 version.

For a brief time, the new page for the game listed Catalyst as launching on Switch 2 in 2028, alongside the other gaming platforms as expected. This information was later removed, yet judging by the fact Legacy of Atlantis is also launching on Nintendo's flagship console, it is hardly surprising that Catalyst will be as well. With that said, there is still a deafening silence around specific details about the game, other than the Northern India setting and the brief details about the story and where it fits in the wider canon.

It is worth considering that this may have been a mistake and that the date and Switch 2 release may have just been errors in the system, or copied over from Legacy of Atlantis . What the situation does highlight, though, is that the Switch 2 is now positioned as more than just a comfy handheld device that can only run and play Nintendo exclusives and smaller indie games. Where in the past, flagship consoles from PlayStation and Xbox were the best place to enjoy modern AAA games, nowadays, Switch owners are getting a much bigger slice of the pie, making the console a much more versatile investment than ever before.

Remakes Mean Series Revivals

Remasters and remakes have taken the gaming world by storm, with everything from Ocarina of Time to Silent Hill getting a modern coat of paint to bring it in line with today's expectations and values. As great as it is to see classics return to the spotlight, the more important debate is around how remakes can actually be a great way to reignite interest in an older franchise, particularly if you pair them with new mainline entries.

If we look at Resident Evil, for instance, Capcom went big and bold with Resident Evil 7 and then followed it up with several remakes, leading to a wave of attention and praise that gave them all the momentum they needed to bring the series back from the brink. In the case of Tomb Raider , we might be seeing that same strategy, with Legacy of Atlantis warming us up for the big new event of Catalyst. It also allows teams of developers to get used to using a new engine like Unreal Engine 5, to then translate those skills into future projects, whether they be more remakes or fresh mainline entries.

New Tomb Raider Nintendo Switch 2 Release Leaked
5 Most Unplayable Masterpieces On The PlayStation 1, Ranked
PS Plus November 2026 Is Giving Tomb Raider's Most Divisive Era Another Chance
Tomb Raider Game Shadow Dropped for Switch 2

That's the real takeaway from these new Tomb Raider games, as regardless of whether they both launch in the next two years on the Switch 2, we are still going to have Lara Croft center stage once again, and hopefully for much longer after. It is a good sign of things to come that the publisher is willing to push out two games in such a short window, and if they are happy to put in the extra work to have them released on more platforms, then I think it is well worth it for the players and the people working day and night to make it happen.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is Being Review Bombed
item.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 launched to record-breaking sales and critic reviews, but the same cannot be said for user reviews. Developer Rockstar Games and publisher Take-Two Interactive report that GTA 6 launched with 32.5 million pre-orders and amassed $3.79 billion dollars in just forty hours, catapulting it into the top 30 best-selling games of all time. On Metacritic, it has over 150 critic reviews and has managed to hold onto a 99 Metascore, which is practically unheard of. Unfortunately, that's not what its user reviews look like.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

It's worth mentioning that review bombing is defined as a large number of users deliberately leaving negative reviews for a game, movie, or product, often to protest something unrelated to its actual quality. That's almost certainly the case here, especially given the numbers at play. For GTA 6 (alongside any other game), Metacritic prevents user reviews within a limited time span. Even then, even if someone used the New Zealand Trick, it's all but impossible to have beaten GTA 6 right now and to form a full opinion on it as a result.

All GTA 6 Cheats

Here's a full list of all GTA 6 cheat codes.

By Jake Fillery

GTA 6 is Being Review-Bombed on Metacritic

As of this writing, Grand Theft Auto 6 has a Generally Unfavorable 4.9 out of 10 review score. While some of the reviews levy reasonable complaints against the game, many others point toward "woke" or "DEI" agendas, blaming everything from GTA 6 's story to its protagonists to its relationship mechanics for reasons why the game supposedly isn't good. It stands to reason some of these reviews will be removed, as Metacritic grapples with the influx of user reviews, which it hopefully expected.

It's worth noting that some review bombs have been more severe, resulting in otherwise good games having scores as low as 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, or worse, so it stands to reason that the reason its review bomb isn't as bad in context is the number of good reviews being left. When it comes to any game review, much less GTA 6 reviews, the general audience is less likely to speak up. In other words, GTA 6 's positive user reviews speak to its quality way more than the negative reviews.

That said, some of the more mixed and possibly negative reviews have merit (once the DEI/woke complaints are sorted out). Some do not like how it is a slower experience, in some regards being more of a modern sequel to Red Dead Redemption 2 than Grand Theft Auto 5, among other critiques. It's obviously very different and way more realistic than prior Grand Theft Auto games, and some fans are going to be disappointed/not like things about it, as is the case with any game launch, but it's a true open-world Rockstar game like any of its predecessors. Its sales speak volumes.

As GameRant wrote in its review of Grand Theft Auto 6 , "Realism can be the enemy of fun, but as Grand Theft Auto has expanded to explore every facet of its open world crime premise, it only makes sense that your approach to that wrongdoing evolves and the consequences of those actions feel slightly more meaningful. And yet GTA 6 is unbelievably fun, with a world that is a joy to simply exist in...This is an experience that’s meant to be savored—packed with surprises and fun details just waiting for players to discover. If this is what a 13-year wait delivers, then Grand Theft Auto 6 was more than worth it."

Grand Theft Auto 6

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Won't Lead to Real Life Crimes, But Police Don't Know That
item.description:
Following the long-awaited arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6 , police departments across the US have issued public service announcements to remind citizens that crimes committed carry actual punishments for those who disobey the law. Officers instead encouraged GTA 6 players to practice their gaming skills safely at home and to stay out of trouble.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

As the most anticipated game of 2026, GTA 6 is the first new mainline release in Rockstar Games' action franchise since 2013. Although the game garnered some controversy for capping its frame rate at 30 frames per second (FPS), that has not stopped millions of gamers from jumping into Vice City on their PS5 or Xbox Series X/S console. Reviews of GTA 6 have been just as overwhelmingly positive across the board, with critics citing the game's sheer scope and the story of Jason and Lucia as some of Rockstar's best work to date.

GTA 6 Xbox Players Risk Getting Banned If They Don't Make Important Settings Change

Grand Theft Auto 6 players on Xbox need to be aware of one setting that runs the risk of getting them accidentally banned online.

By Joshua Duckworth

Police Officers Remind GTA 6 Players to Keep Criminal Activity Out of Real Life

Though GTA 6 has a criminal profile system that determines how Jason and Lucia are perceived by NPCs around Vice City and Leonida, reality is way less forgiving. Following GTA 6 's global launch, police officers around the US have taken to social media to warn players that attempting to commit the franchise's titular crime or other serious offenses are completely against the law. For example, the San Juan Police Department (SJPD), located in Texas' Rio Grande Valley region, shared an Instagram video to remind players to keep any criminal activities strictly to within the game. SJPD said that failing to obey the rules of the road would lead to real-life consequences, including potential felony charges. These crimes include, but are not limited to, running red lights, ignoring traffic signs on the road, and attempted burglary.

While GTA 6 's heat level system can be dealt with in various ways, such as changing appearances or vehicles, getting any real-life attention from police officers will not result in any heat being taken off at all. SJPD said that getting a six-star wanted level in reality is not a challenge for players to go for, but instead a felony offense that will result in prison time at a minimum. The department instead encouraged players to responsibly enjoy their time with Rockstar's latest game from home, and to keep reckless behavior strictly within the streets of Leonida.

The worldwide popularity of GTA 6 has quickly become a cultural phenomenon and a financial boon for Rockstar Games and its parent company, Take-Two Interactive. According to Jason Schreier of Bloomberg, GTA 6 has already made $3.79 billion just 24 hours after the game was released, with over 32.5 million pre-orders sold across the globe. Schreier said that GTA 6 has already made more money in a day than the Marvel movie Avengers: Endgame did in its box office run. While Endgame amassed $2.94 billion, Rockstar's latest game earned $850 million more than that.

Two days before the game went live, GTA 6 scored eight nominations at The Game Awards 2026, including the coveted Game of the Year honors. With other titles such as Resident Evil Requiem and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time also in contention, time will tell how many awards GTA 6 will take home at this year's show.

Grand Theft Auto 6

item.title: Should You Pay Lenny’s Debt in ROB RUN?
item.description:
Paying off Lenny’s debt is one of those decisions in ROB RUN that makes you stop and think before spending your hard-earned money. After all, one million credits is not exactly pocket change. Lenny promises to let you settle your outstanding debt, but what do you actually get in return?

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover
How To Get a Decoder in Rob Run

Here’s how you can get a Decoder in ROB RUN and use it to raid other bases and bypass security systems.

By Usama Ali

What Happens When You Finally Pay Lenny in ROB RUN?

Lenny's debt is a million credit objective that becomes available after you escape prison during the introduction. He helped you get out, but that favor comes with a pretty hefty price tag. Eventually, you'll need to return to his motel with the required amount in your bank account and settle what you owe.

The payment isn’t that difficult to complete once you start earning money. The expensive part is actually preparing the funds, since Lenny won't accept dirty cash from your robberies. You need to launder your earnings first and transfer the resulting money into your bank account.

Once you have the full million, visit Lenny's Motel and interact with him to select the Pay Debt option. Completing the transaction finishes the objective and unlocks its associated rewards.

  • The most noticeable reward is the New Chapter outfit, which changes your character's appearance. You can find it in the Skin Center after completing the payment.
  • You'll also unlock the Pay Your Debt to Lenny achievement, marking the completion of this particular objective.
  • The third reward is an extra 10 years of jail time added to your accumulated total. This is probably the most interesting part for players who care about long-term progression.

Is Lenny's Debt Worth Paying in ROB RUN?

Honestly, I wouldn't make Lenny's debt an early-game priority. Spending a million credits just to change your character's appearance isn't that appealing when you could use that money to improve your base, get better equipment, and make your criminal activities more profitable.

The 10-year jail time bonus is a nice addition, especially if you're close to unlocking a Black Market shipment. However, unless you need those extra years for a specific requirement, there's little reason to sacrifice your early game finances for it.

Paying off the debt is more of a long-term objective. Your base should be one of your priorities because it gives you access to useful facilities, including your own Laundering Desk. Having a reliable place to process dirty money makes future financial activities much easier.

Build your operation first, invest in useful upgrades, and let your income become more consistent. Once you've secured everything you need for the current server cycle, you can start preparing the million credits for Lenny.If a Federal Raid is approaching, and you have money left over, that's the best time to pay Lenny’s debt and complete the objective.

Thankfully, the New Chapter outfit and accumulated jail time are permanent rewards. They will not be wiped away from your regular progress during a Federal Raid.

item.title: How to Use the First-Person Mode Glitch in GTA 6
item.description:
Rockstar Games launched GTA 6 without a first-person mode, limiting players to a third-person camera except when checking their smartphone or aiming certain weapons. However, it didn't take long for the community to find a clever camera exploit that bypasses that restriction entirely. Here is how to trigger the GTA 6 first-person mode glitch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and switch back to third-person when you're done.
